results.note: Antikeimenon: Found reference to a Spanish translation/reconstruction with partial English on Academia.edu, but no published complete English translation identified. Requires further verification.
Apologeticus: No English translation found in searches; work appears in Latin editions only.
Commentarius in Nahum: No English translation located despite searches for biblical commentaries on Nahum.
De comprobatione sextae aetatis: Latin edition exists (Corpus Christianorum, 1976; Brepols, 2010) but no English translation found.
Elogium: No English translation found in research.
Historia rebellionis Pauli: English translation 'The Story of Wamba: Julian of Toledo's Historia Wambae Regis' by Joaquin Martinez Pizarro (Catholic University of America Press, 2005).
Orationes: No English translation located.

Prognosticon: English translation 'Prognosticum futuri saeculi: Foreknowledge of the World to Come' translated by Tommaso Stancati, published in Ancient Christian Writers vol. 63 (Newman Press, 2010).
Adnotatiunculae in collationes Joannis Cassiani: No English translation found.
Commentarius in omnes epistolas Pauli: Extensive medieval commentary exists in Migne PL 150 but no English translation located.
De celanda confessione: Brief work described as address on primatical authority; no English translation found.

De corpore et sanguine Domini: English translation 'On the Body and Blood of the Lord; On the Truth of the Body and Blood of Christ in the Eucharist' translated by Mark G. Vaillancourt (Catholic University of America Press, Fathers of the Church Medieval Continuations series).
Decreta pro ordine S. Benedicti: Bilingual Latin/English edition edited by David Knowles (Nelson, 1951), with parallel texts for Lanfranc's monastic constitutions.
Epistolae: 'The Letters of Lanfranc, Archbishop of Canterbury' edited and translated by Helen Clover and Margaret Gibson (Oxford Medieval Texts, Clarendon Press, 1979).
Pericope orationis: Brief fragmentary work; no English translation found.
Sermo: Short sermon; no English translation located.
Carmina sacra et preces: Sacred poems and prayers; no English translation found.
Credulitas: No English translation located.
Epistolae: Letters of Odilo; no English translation found.
Epitaphium Adalheidae: Vita of Holy Roman Empress Adelaide; no English translation identified despite Latin editions in MGH and PL 142.
Hymni in vigilia Maioli: Hymns for vigil of St. Maiolus; no English translation found.
Sermones: Collection of sermons; no English translation located.
Statutum de defunctis: Statute/decree for the dead; no English translation found.
Vita Maioli: Life of St. Maiolus; no English translation identified despite references in AASS and PL.
De blasphemia: No English translation located.
De canonibus evangeliorum: Brief treatise on gospel canons; no English translation found.

De peccato originali: 'On Original Sin and A Disputation with the Jew, Leo, Concerning the Advent of Christ, the Son of God. Two Theological Treatises' translated and edited by Irven M. Resnick (University of Pennsylvania Press, 1994).
Diplomata: Diplomatic documents; no English translation found.
Disputatio contra Judaeum: Included in Irven M. Resnick's translation 'On Original Sin and A Disputation with the Jew' (University of Pennsylvania Press, 1994) alongside De peccato originali.
Expositio in canone missae: Exposition on Canon of the Mass; no English translation located.
Homilia de villico iniquitatis: Homily; no English translation found.
Liber de villico iniquitatis: Book on steward of iniquity; no English translation identified.
Acta collationis Romanae: Brief text recording Roman collation; no English translation found.
Collectiones in epistolas et evangelia: Large homiliary (219,674 words) on epistles and gospels; no English translation located despite existence in PL 102.
Diadema monachorum (Crown of Monks): Translated by David Barry OSB (Cistercian Publications, Cistercian Studies series).
Praefatio: Brief preface; no English translation found.
Summarium in epistolas et evangelia: Summary/epitome of epistles and gospels; no English translation identified.
Versus Smaragdi: Brief verses; no English translation located.
Via regia (The Royal Way): Critical edition with full English translation by M. Ponesse and J.F. LePree (Dallas Medieval Texts and Translations, vol. 30; Peeters-Leuven, 9789042950405).
Commentaria in regulam Sancti Benedicti (Commentary on the Rule of St. Benedict): Translated by David Barry OSB (Cistercian Publications, 2007).
